title: Dutch Burghers and Portuguese Mechanics: Eurasian Ethnicity in Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: Dennis B. McGilvray / Comparative Studies in Society and History / Cambridge University Press
scope: Burgher ethnicity, Portuguese- and Dutch-derived communities, with particular attention to Batticaloa and eastern Sri Lanka.
limitations: Ethnographic-historical analysis of Burgher identity; not a primary source for seventeenth-century fort chronology or a licence to project later Burgher categories unchanged backward.

title: Dutch Burghers and Portuguese Mechanics: Eurasian Ethnicity in Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: Dennis B. McGilvray / Comparative Studies in Society and History / Cambridge University Press
scope: Social construction and regional differentiation of Portuguese and Dutch Burgher identities in Sri Lanka.
limitations: Same publication retained under the identifier referenced by the Run46 colonial-layers bridge; duplicate publication identifiers represent existing lineage aliases, not independent corroboration.

title: The Portuguese Burghers of Eastern Sri Lanka in the Wake of Civil War and Tsunami
author_or_institution: Dennis B. McGilvray / in Jorge Flores (ed.), Re-exploring the Links: History and Constructed Histories between Portugal and Sri Lanka
scope: Portuguese Burgher communities in eastern Sri Lanka, especially Batticaloa, including language, Christianity, identity and social continuity.
limitations: Modern ethnographic/historical study; supports persistence and identity formation, not a timeless ethnic category or direct continuity of every colonial administrative role.
